s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of upper gastrointestinal bleeding with epigastric pain
salient_findings: Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration
key_facts: One-week history of epigastric pain and hematemesis
No significant medical or surgical history
Hemoglobin level rose to 10 g/dL after transfusion
Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration on endoscopy
Well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass on CT

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of upper gastrointestinal bleeding with epigastric pain
salient_findings: Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration
key_facts: One-week history of epigastric pain and hematemesis

Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration on endoscopy
Well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass on CT

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal lesion with ulceration and heterogeneous mass on CT

shortlist.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Upper gastrointestinal bleeding and mass in the gastric antrum

shortlist.label: Peptic ulcer disease
shortlist.why_kept: Epigastric pain and hematemesis with ulceration on endoscopy

shortlist.label: Gastric leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal lesion and well-defined mass on CT

shortlist.label: Dieulafoy's lesion
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of upper gastrointestinal bleeding

raw.rationale: The presence of a submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration of the overlying mucosa and a well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass on CT, along with the absence of malignant features on biopsy, is most consistent with a gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST), which can present with bleeding and often appears as a submucosal mass on endoscopy and imaging.

rejected.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Biopsy showed no malignant features, making gastric adenocarcinoma less likely

rejected.label: Peptic ulcer disease
rejected.why: The presence of a submucosal lesion and a well-defined mass on CT is not typical for peptic ulcer disease

rejected.label: Gastric leiomyoma
rejected.why: While possible, the heterogeneous nature of the mass on CT and the presence of ulceration are more suggestive of GIST

rejected.label: Dieulafoy's lesion
rejected.why: Dieulafoy's lesion typically presents as a small, bleeding mucosal lesion without a significant submucosal mass
